name: Hibachi-San
notes: All 6 photos are digital menu boards for a sushi/poke counter (grab-and-go rolls, build-your-own poke bowls, tea bar and fountain drinks) rather than a hibachi grill, despite the listing name. Photos 3, 4 and 5 show three different versions of the poke-bowl builder (varying protein and topping lists, and two different base prices: $11.40/$13.00 in photo 3 vs $8.55/$10.05 in photo 4) — likely photographed at different times as the menu changed. Used photo 6's dedicated pricing sign ($11.40 small / $13.00 regular) as canonical since it was the clearest, most recent-looking price source. Builder components (base, protein, topping, sauce choices) are modifiers/options rather than discrete dishes and were omitted per the extraction rules; only the fixed-price roll and drink items, plus the two poke bowl sizes, are listed.
